name: Concat
description: Concatenative cross-synthesis on live streams. Matches frames of the source against the control input using four spectral features (zero-crossing rate, log mean square, spectral centroid, spectral tilt) — the source frames best matching the control are output. Frozen mode locks the source database. By Nick Collins. From sc3-plugins ConcatUGens.

inputs.name: control
inputs.description: Audio-rate control input — drives matching

inputs.name: source
inputs.description: Audio-rate source input — frames are stored and selected for playback

inputs.name: storesize
inputs.description: Size of the source store sample buffer in seconds

inputs.name: seektime
inputs.description: Time in seconds into the past to start searching for matches

inputs.name: seekdur
inputs.description: Time in seconds from seektime towards the present to test matches

inputs.name: matchlength
inputs.description: Match length in seconds (rounded to the nearest FFT frame)

inputs.name: freezestore
inputs.description: Stop collecting novel source input — keep store fixed when > 0

inputs.name: zcr
inputs.description: Weight for zero-crossing-rate feature

inputs.name: lms
inputs.description: Weight for log-mean-square amplitude feature

inputs.name: sc
inputs.description: Weight for spectral-centroid feature

inputs.name: st
inputs.description: Weight for spectral-tilt feature

inputs.name: randscore
inputs.description: Random score added to matching (introduces variation)

name: Concat2
description: Improved live concatenative cross-synthesis on live streams. Like Concat but adds a threshold parameter for a 'better live concatenative synthesiser' — matches below the threshold are rejected. By Nick Collins. From sc3-plugins ConcatUGens.
